_: House opener photos for the listing pages (Stage 3, 10 Nov 2026). One entry per page slug. src: a real model photo of a piece sold on that page. my / dy: where the phone (5:6) and desktop (4:5) crops start, 0 = top of the source, 1 = bottom. mpos / dpos: object-position inside the opener. words: top or bottom, whichever keeps the words off the print and the face. alt says what is shown, never a place the photo was not taken at. Run tools/make-open.py after changing src, my or dy.
